narr: Scattered thunderstorms on the afternoon of August 3rd produced large hail and caused flash flooding in Lyman County. Heavy rainfall from these storms led to a trained spotter reporting water flowing over roads in West Brule.
ev: A trained spotter reported water flowing over the roads in West Brule.
lsr: Water over the roads in West Brule. Pea to nickel size hail. Still raining heavily.
